unit.goal: Strona patcha ładuje cały plik z domyślnej projekcji trasy detalu, bez względu na jego długość, więc autozapis nie gubi końca pliku.

orchestratorNotes: Constraint for rev-0001: `origin: 'server'` is set for EVERY write the app performs (src/server/fs/watcher.ts takeOrigin), including writes by agents/MCP tools (update_patch) and by other tabs — an open patch screen must still refresh on those. Do not drop the detail invalidation for all server-origin events; suppress only the echo of this tab's own save (e.g. the cache already holds the written content/hash for that path), and test both: own-save echo → no detail refetch; another server-origin write → detail refetched.

The finding notes the brief screen (useFileWatcher.ts:73, unit m21, already verified) has the same echo. Fix the shared watcher mechanism once so it covers briefs and patches alike; keep brief behaviour otherwise unchanged and keep its existing tests green. Plans belong to the next unit (m10): do not change the plans branch.
